subject: Math
text_verbatim: 4. What is being sold at the 2nd stall? Leap and Learn Bunty and Babloo continue walking. They see more stalls with numbers from 11th to 20th. They first stop at a stall with pretty paper lanterns. Bunty says, "This is the 11th stall. We say it as 'eleventh.'" Next, they see a stall with many spices. Bunty points and says, "This is the 12th stall. We call it 'twelfth.'" They move to a stall with wooden toys. Bunty explains, "This one is 13th. It's 'thirteenth.'" A stall with colourful kites is next. Bunty tells Babloo, "This is the 14th stall. We say 'fourteenth.'" 20

exercises.answer_key: Food — a bowl of rice/biryani with a chicken drumstick, per the 2nd stall illustrated on the previous page (printed 19).

illustrations.description: 11th stall (red/white striped awning, brown counter): three paper lanterns — a blue rectangular lantern, a green cylindrical lantern, and a red round lantern with hanging tassels.
12th stall (yellow/white striped awning, brown counter): two spice mounds — a pink/red conical mound and a white conical mound.
13th stall (green/white striped awning, brown counter): two yellow-and-green wooden toy trains with red wheels.
14th stall (purple/white striped awning, brown counter): three kites — a purple/blue folded kite, a red kite on a string, and a yellow-and-green diamond kite.
